toolprompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: horizontal character turnaround sheet for a game art reference
Input image 1 is the approved Tina character design and the only visual reference. Preserve Tina exactly: red hair in her high ponytail, amber eyes, cheek bandage, green scarf, light swordswoman armor/chestplate, belt, sheathed sword and equipment, clothing colors, face, proportions, and bold simple anime-manga cel style.
Create one wide horizontal sheet with exactly THREE full-body drawings of the same Tina, equally spaced left to right, all at identical scale with the same head-top and foot-bottom baseline:
1) FRONT: strict 0-degree front-facing neutral standing view.
2) SIDE: strict 90-degree true side profile facing toward the RIGHT side of the sheet.
3) BACK: strict 180-degree rear view.
Neutral turnaround pose: both arms relaxed slightly away from the torso, hands natural, feet parallel and stable, no dramatic action pose, no exaggerated T-pose. Keep all hair, boots, sword, scarf, armor and accessories fully visible. Rotate asymmetric items consistently around the body: cheek bandage is only seen on the corresponding front-side face, sword/sheath and pouches remain on their physical hip, ponytail and scarf tail follow the rotation. The back view must show a restrained reasonable continuation of the approved outfit without inventing decorative armor or weapons that are not implied.
Background: flat white to warm ivory, no perspective, no ground shadows or dramatic lighting, clean even studio presentation. Keep generous spacing between the three figures and do not crop any head, hair, weapon, or feet.
Add only small English labels FRONT, SIDE, BACK below the corresponding figures. No other text, no character name, no watermark.
Avoid: any 3/4 angle, diagonal pose, different scale, extra figures, duplicated limbs, redesigning Tina, new equipment, cinematic background.
